artworks.title: Hector Taking Leave of Andromache
artworks.description: The farewell of Iliad 6 — Hector and Andromache at the Scaean gate before the champion of Troy returns to the battle from which Achilles will fetch him home dead.

artworks.title: Triumphant Achilles
artworks.description: Achilles drags Hector before the walls — the wrath that burned through ten years of siege and poisoned every victor's homecoming.
